keywords.def: Choosing an occupation or profession you will follow for a significant period of life, which gives chances for progress and prosperity.
Step 1: listing all the career opportunities available in your area.
Step 4: choosing one single career based on research, evaluation and discussion.
A written document listing all the steps to reach your career goals: a roadmap from A to B to C to D.

en.text: Career selection means choosing an occupation for a significant part of life. The four steps are research, evaluation, discussion and decision. To find the right career, make and shorten a list, get information, choose, set short- and long-term goals, and write a career action plan.

screens.title: Unit summary
paras: Career selection is choosing an occupation for a significant period of life that gives opportunities for progress and prosperity.
Four steps: research career opportunities in the locality; evaluate them; discuss the selected careers; decide on a single career.
Finding the right career: list, explore, narrow down, get information, choose, set goals, make an action plan.
